causality: Inverted on purpose. shape_for picks the SHAPE first (guaranteeing all six shapes inside every six floors), then origin_for draws from the origins that could plausibly have made that shape. A cavern is always a lair or a buried town; a cross is always a fortress or a tomb.
chronicle_line: Floor 2  —  a workshop, remade as a sunken meadow:  3 slimes.
word_order: Origin first, biome second. 'a sunken meadow, once a workshop' reads like a mistake.
casing: Godot's String.capitalize() title-cases EVERY word, so the text after the em dash stays lowercase.
budget: One 'tell' line per delve, on floor 1 only.
